name: Soap Micelle with Central Oil Droplet
semanticDescription: 3D spherical colloidal soap micelle cluster with hydrophobic hydrocarbon tails embedded inwards around a central oil droplet and hydrophilic polar ionic carboxylate heads projecting outward into water (CBSE Class 10 Chemistry Ch 4 Figure 4.12).
simplifications: 16 radial amphiphilic soap molecules arrayed around central oil sphere.
Hydrophobic tails shown as zig-zag aliphatic rods and heads as charged ionic spheres.

materials.look: Bright polar ionic carboxylate head (blue-violet sphere, -COO- Na+)
Non-polar hydrophobic carbon chain (gold/amber zig-zag tail)
Translucent organic oil/grease dirt core droplet
